data.title: Solar System Explorer
data.description: Embark on an amazing journey to explore the Sun and the planets in our cosmic neighborhood. Discover how these fascinating worlds move and interact in space!

bodies.name: Sun
bodies.description: The Sun is our star! It's a giant ball of hot gas that gives us light and warmth.
bodies.funFact: The Sun is so big that over 1 million Earths could fit inside it!

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.description: Mercury is a rocky planet with lots of craters, and it lives very close to the Sun.
bodies.funFact: Mercury zips around the Sun in just 88 days.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.description: Venus is often called Earth's sister planet because they are similar in size, but it is covered in thick, swirling clouds.
bodies.funFact: A day on Venus is longer than its year!

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.description: Earth is our home! It has liquid water, an amazing atmosphere, and plenty of life.
bodies.funFact: Earth is the only planet not named after a god or goddess!

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: Mars is a rocky world featuring huge volcanoes and deep canyons across its terrain.
bodies.funFact: Mars looks red because its soil contains rusty iron!

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.description: Jupiter is a massive gas giant with swirling colorful bands and a famous giant storm.
bodies.funFact: Jupiter has a vast family of moons orbiting around it!

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.description: Saturn is a gas giant wrapped in stunning, bright rings made of icy chunks and rock.
bodies.funFact: Saturn is so light it could float in water if you had a big enough bathtub!

bodies.name: Uranus
bodies.description: Uranus is an icy blue-green giant that rotates in a very unusual way compared to other worlds.
bodies.funFact: Uranus rolls around the Sun like a ball instead of spinning like a top!

bodies.name: Neptune
bodies.description: Neptune is an icy blue world swept by powerful winds in the outer reaches of the system.
bodies.funFact: Neptune experiences some of the fastest winds in our cosmic neighborhood!

bodies.name: Pluto
bodies.description: Pluto is a small, cold, icy world located in the distant outer regions of space.
bodies.funFact: Pluto features a unique heart-shaped region on its icy surface!
